notes: Sepolia project launch. Bid has a zero-argument constructor that mints its entire fixed supply to its deployer, with no later mint path. SealedBidAuction takes only the deployed BID address via $token. Neither contract has an owner, administrator, upgrade mechanism, or fee; no initialization calls are required. Sellers list off-chain item identifiers with a reserve and commit deadline. Bidders commit domain-separated hashes and lock BID, then reveal during the following one-day window. The highest valid revealed bid wins; ties favor the earlier commitment. Anyone may finalize after the reveal window, crediting the winning price to the seller for withdrawal. Other bidders, including non-revealers, withdraw their full locks; the winner withdraws any excess. Item ownership and delivery are not enforced. Only the supplied exact-transfer BID is supported. Application mutations use a shared reentrancy guard, checks-effects-interactions, and events. The native-ETH pool has no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, not a promised valuation. Independent review must cover the final manifest and accepted implementation before deployment. Contributors never broadcast; only the authorized deployer executes the admitted release.
